notes: Assets cropped from the approved Meowza art direction sheet. UI structure, board grid, buttons, toggles, shadows and responsive layout should remain HTML/CSS/JS; use raster assets for illustrated identity and decorative richness.

recommended_usage.board: Use board-frame-blue.png as a proportional square background/frame and overlay a CSS Grid (4x4, 5x5, 6x6). Never bake cells into the frame.
recommended_usage.tiles: Prefer CSS tiles for dynamic states; tile PNGs are visual reference/optional overlays.
recommended_usage.cats: Use grey-board/orange-board for 4x4 and 5x5; use small variants on 6x6 if needed.
recommended_usage.rules: Use same-circle.png for SAME and different-circle.png for DIFFERENT markers.
recommended_usage.buttons: Implement button shells in CSS and use raster art only where needed. Avoid stretching text baked into PNG buttons.
recommended_usage.home: home-cozy.png can be used as hero/background artwork on the main menu.
